promos.note: HELD live for a 7th consecutive run (now a full week unverified). Checked both the community page and the linked /event/5.49 footnote subpage directly again this run: the words 'permanent' and 'life of the loan' still do not appear anywhere; the offer is described only as a time-boxed 30-Year Fixed promotional rate tied to a contract-signing window, with standard underwriting conditions (loan-amount band, 740 credit score assumption, primary-residence-only, FHA/VA excluded), lender-tied to Toll Brothers Mortgage Company (NMLS #18154). Carried in promos[] because the stated loan type is explicitly '30-Year Fixed' (not an ARM, not a declared 2-1/3-2-1/introductory buydown), which meets this sweep's inclusion test -- but a full week without the word 'permanent' appearing anywhere is long enough that we are no longer comfortable carrying this forward on text-matching alone. RECOMMENDATION: call the sales office (833-405-8655) before the next run to confirm in plain language whether this rate resets after any period, or drop it from promos[] if unconfirmed by the next publish.
